coordinates.map_m: x = east, y = north, z = metres above grade (the whole stage is flat at grade 0); origin = Century Tower
coordinates.game: X = (x - cx) * 100, Y = z * 100, Z = -(y - cy) * 100 with (cx, cy) = center_m = (-470, -293); Y is the ray-cast collision floor (Mario's feet). Objects that hover (stars, coins) add their own offset.
coordinates.game_box: {x0, x1, z0, z1[, y0, y1]} in game units (x0 < x1, z0 < z1)
coordinates.floor_m: collision floor measured by ray-casting the built level (STAND_FROM_M above the design height, straight down)

note: Anchor points for the Course 2 mission author (docs/game_design.md 7.2, Reitz Union & Engineering Quad, slot wf / LEVEL_WF, door 2 = The Hub). Re-generated on every `build_stage.py -- reitz_eng` from the built collision. Points with a 'check' key did not measure as designed. 'actN_' keys use the DESIGN act numbers (1 Rooftop of the Reitz, 2 Remote Robotics Lab (2P), 3 Weil Wind Tunnel, 4 Rogue Robot Roundup, 5 Meal Swipe Tokens, 6 Data Packet Relay); the course acts are numbered by course.lua (playable acts 1..n, solo first, docs/flow.md 5.1). The level script has NO level-script star (stars = []): every mission spawns its own (spawn_default_star from the controller loop, star id = course act - 1), or build_stage.py STAGE_STARS gets the act 1 entry.

act1_rooftop.note: Climb the Reitz Union from the ravine side: brick terraces 1.5 / 3.0 / 4.5 -> copper awnings 6.7 / 8.9 / 11.1 -> ballroom roof 13.2 -> AC unit 15.4 -> podium roof 17.6 -> (window-washer lift, its 9 m cable pole, or the four east sunshade ledges 19.8-25.2) -> tower roof 26.4 / parapet 27.0 -> elevator penthouse 28.8 (star). Second route from the South Terrace (2.0 -> canopy 5.6 -> light shelves 7.8 / 10.0 -> food court roof 11.5 -> AC 13.8 -> green roof 16.0 -> podium 17.6). Every rise is <= 2.4 m except the 3.6 m double jump onto the canopy.

act3_wind_tunnel.note: The wind-tunnel floor vent (stage dressing: a steel grate on a 0.4 m curb, r 2.6 m) east of the Weil Cooling Towers (11 m, roof deck 10.0 inside a 1 m parapet). Mission: a big floor button (button) turns on a vertical-wind column over the vent (SURFACE_VERTICAL_WIND object, ACT_VERTICAL_WIND) that lifts riders past the towers' roof to the star; someone holds the button or the fan spins down. The towers' east face has the generator's climb route (entrance canopy 3 m + ledges 6 / 9 m) up to the roof = the cooling-tower catwalk.
